description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (PC) Rules and FSSAI Packaging & Labelling Regulations.

requirements.title: Food Product Name & Description
requirements.description: Clear name of the food commodity indicating its true nature.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print standardized food designation on Principal Display Panel.

requirements.title: Net Quantity (Weight / Volume)
requirements.description: Net quantity in standard metric units (g, kg for solids, ml, L for liquids).
requirements.recommendation_template: Verify declared net weight/volume meets statutory pack size requirements.

requirements.title: Retail Sale Price (MRP)
requirements.description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print MRP in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes.

requirements.title: Best Before / Expiry Date
requirements.description: 'Best Before' date or 'Use By' date is mandatory for all prepackaged food products.
requirements.recommendation_template: Declare clear 'Best Before [Month/Year]' or 'Use By [DD/MM/YYYY]' statement.

requirements.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Marketer Details
requirements.description: Name and complete physical address of manufacturer/packer.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure manufacturer name, factory address, and corporate office are printed.

requirements.title: Consumer Grievance / Customer Care Details
requirements.description: Customer care helpline, email, and postal contact.
requirements.recommendation_template: Include customer service phone number and feedback email.
